Delivery of 40 shrink-wraps booked in at 09:15. On visual inspection, the shrink-wrap on two of the pallets was split and the corner of one ream was crushed. The crushed ream was on the top layer of pallet 2, so it was easily spotted. Qty Expected: 40 shrink-wraps (200 reams)
Qty Damaged: 2 split shrink-wraps (contents intact), 1 crushed ream (unsaleable)

Crushed ream removed and set aside for return. The two split shrink-wraps were re-wrapped on site using our stretch-wrap machine and put into stock, as the reams inside were clean and dry. Photographs taken of the crushed ream and the split shrink-wraps. Delivery note flagged with a yellow sticker. Supplier called at 09:35 and asked to email a photo of the damaged ream. They said they would arrange a credit note for the one ream and a replacement delivery for the two split wraps, but the replacement would have to come with the next scheduled delivery (due 20/03/2024).

Corrective Action (Supplier):
Peakline to issue credit note for 1 ream and to replace the 2 split shrink-wraps on next delivery. They also said they would remind the loading team to check shrink-wrap condition before despatch.
